topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 71 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
